facts_found: Formal credit card transaction disputes are filed by the agent using the internal tool file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829; the tool must first be unlocked with unlock_discoverable_agent_tool and then invoked with call_discoverable_agent_tool using a JSON string of arguments. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

Required arguments for file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829: transaction_id, card_action, card_last_4_digits, full_name, user_id, phone, email, address, contacted_merchant, purchase_date, issue_noticed_date, dispute_reason, resolution_requested, optional partial_refund_amount, and eligible_for_provisional_credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]
The dispute reason code for 'never received what was paid for' is 'goods_services_not_received'. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

card_action 'keep_active' means keep the card active and just dispute the charge; 'cancel_and_reissue' is used when the card is being cancelled and replaced. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]
eligible_for_provisional_credit is a boolean the agent must determine from the Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines article. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

Provisional credit for a credit card dispute requires ALL of: account open at least 60 days; reason is 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge', 'duplicate_charge', or 'goods_services_not_received' (only if the purchase was made more than 30 days ago); amount at least $25.00 and not exceeding the card tier maximum; no more than 2 disputes filed in the past 12 months; and for non-fraud disputes the customer must have attempted to resolve with the merchant first. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]
Silver Rewards Card is Mid Tier with a maximum provisional credit limit of $5000.00. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

A 'goods_services_not_received' dispute where the purchase was made within the last 30 days is NOT eligible for provisional credit because the merchant may still be processing delivery. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

Customer guidance recommends contacting the merchant first for non-fraud issues, but says customers should contact Rho-Bank right away if they already tried the merchant without success. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]
'Goods or Services Not Received' (paid for something but never received it) is an explicitly listed valid credit card dispute reason. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]

Customers file credit card disputes by contacting customer service (1-800-RHO-BANK, mobile app chat, or rhobank.com/help); representatives gather the information and file the dispute on the customer's behalf, with account info plus purchase date, merchant name, and amount. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]

There is no customer self-service tool for credit card transaction disputes; the only customer-run dispute tool documented is submit_cash_back_dispute_0589, which applies solely to cash back discrepancies, not non-receipt of goods. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

A user's prior credit card disputes (dates, statuses, reason codes, transaction details) can be retrieved with get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id) — used to verify the 'no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months' provisional credit criterion. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

Provisional credit, when the customer is eligible, is typically applied within a few business days of filing and becomes permanent if the dispute is resolved in the customer's favor, otherwise it is reversed. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_022]

open_questions: The knowledge base states no filing deadline / statute of limitations for credit card transaction disputes (the 60-day reporting deadlines found apply to debit card Regulation E disputes only); the only credit-card date rule documented is the 30-day post-purchase threshold for provisional credit on 'goods_services_not_received'.

The exact tool name/parameters for retrieving the credit card transaction_id for the TechDirect Online charge were not documented in the retrieved articles (only 'credit_card_transaction_history' is referenced generically).
Account age (>= 60 days) and the customer's dispute count in the past 12 months still need to be verified via get_user_dispute_history_7291 before eligible_for_provisional_credit can be finalized.
The customer's issue_noticed_date, requested resolution type, and contact/profile details (full_name, phone, email, address, card_last_4_digits, transaction_id) must still be collected.

events.question: What is the procedure and eligibility criteria for requesting a credit limit increase on a Silver Rewards Card, and what internal tool is used to submit such a request?

facts_found: Silver Rewards Card is classified as Mid-tier (along with Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002]
Mid-tier cards allow a maximum credit limit increase of 50% of the current credit limit per request (Entry-tier 25%, Premium-tier 50%). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_006]

If a customer requests more than the tier maximum, the agent must inform them of the maximum eligible amount and ask whether they want to proceed at that amount instead. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_006]

For this customer's $15,000 current limit, the mid-tier 50% cap equals a maximum increase of $7,500, i.e. a maximum new total limit of $22,500 — the requested ~$22,500 is at (not above) the cap. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_006]

Mid-tier CLI eligibility: minimum account age 90 days, 90-day cooldown between requests, and current credit utilization below 80% at the time of submission (Entry-tier 120/120/70%, Premium-tier 60/60/90%). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_005]
The cooldown applies only if the most recent CLI request was APPROVED; denied requests do not trigger a cooldown period. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_005]
Qualification on account age occurs on or after the day the minimum is reached; utilization at or above the threshold does not qualify. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_005]

Mid-tier cards require 3 consecutive months of on-time payments for a CLI (Entry-tier 6 months, Premium-tier 3 months), verified with get_payment_history_6183. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_006]

The agent workflow steps must be followed in the exact order listed: Step 0 confirm amount within tier limits, Step 1 submit the request, Step 2 verify basic eligibility, Step 3 verify payment history and requested amount, Step 4 process the decision, Step 5 communicate the decision. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]

The internal tool used to submit a CLI request is submit_credit_limit_increase_request_7392 with arguments credit_card_account_id (string, required), user_id (string, required), requested_increase_amount (integer, required — the dollar amount of the INCREASE, e.g. 1000 for a $1,000 increase). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]
The request must be submitted before eligibility checks are performed because eligibility checks are internal and not exposed to customers. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]

Step 2 basic eligibility checks (ALL must be checked for complete audit records): minimum account age for tier; cooldown via get_credit_limit_increase_history_4829; no active/pending disputes; no pending replacement card orders (CLI blocked until replacement is delivered or cancelled); account current with no past-due balance; utilization below the tier maximum. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]
get_credit_limit_increase_history_4829 takes credit_card_account_id (string, required). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]

Approval uses approve_credit_limit_increase_5847(credit_card_account_id, user_id, new_credit_limit) where new_credit_limit is the NEW TOTAL limit to set (float). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]
Denial uses deny_credit_limit_increase_5848(credit_card_account_id, user_id, denial_reason) with denial_reason from a fixed enum. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]
get_payment_history_6183 takes credit_card_account_id (string, required) and months (integer, required — set per card tier; 3 for mid-tier). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_006]

Customer-facing CLI submission requires: current credit card account information, the new total credit limit requested OR the dollar amount of the increase, and a brief reason for the increase (e.g., upcoming large purchase, business expansion, improved financial position); additional information may be requested during review. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_004]

Customers request a CLI by contacting Rho-Bank support through secure in-app chat, secure message from the online account, or phone; there is no documented customer self-service CLI tool — the agent submits it on the customer's behalf. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_004]

Only the account owner or an authorized account manager may submit a CLI request for the account; contact information should be current to receive notifications. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_004]

After submission, Rho-Bank reviews the account and reason and sends a decision by email within a few business days; if approved the new limit takes effect once processed, if denied the customer gets an explanation and when they may reapply. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_004]

Pending replacement card orders for a credit card account are checked with get_pending_replacement_orders_5765(credit_card_account_id); any order in a non-final state (pending/shipped) blocks the account workflow until delivered or cancelled. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_005]

A user's prior credit card disputes (dates, statuses, reason codes, transaction details) can be retrieved with get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id), which can be used to confirm there are no active/pending disputes. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]
The credit_card_account_id for a customer can be obtained by calling get_credit_card_accounts_by_user. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017]

open_questions: Step 3 of the internal CLI workflow ('Verify Payment History and Requested Amount') is truncated in doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007; the only Step 3 detail available comes from doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_006 (3 consecutive on-time months for mid-tier, 50% max increase).

No dedicated tool names are documented for checking 'no pending disputes', 'no past-due balance', and 'current utilization' in the CLI workflow (get_user_dispute_history_7291 and get_pending_replacement_orders_5765 are documented for those respective checks; account status/balance/utilization would come from the credit card account lookup, e.g. get_credit_card_accounts_by_user).

The KB does not state whether submit_credit_limit_increase_request_7392 / approve / deny are discoverable agent tools requiring unlock_discoverable_agent_tool before call_discoverable_agent_tool (unlike the dispute and statement-credit tools, which explicitly say so).

Account-specific data still needed to actually process this request: credit_card_account_id, user_id, account open date, current balance/utilization, past-due status, pending dispute and replacement-order status, CLI history, and 3-month payment history.
The KB does not document any customer self-service tool for credit limit increases (only agent-side tools), and does not state an explicit identity-verification requirement for CLI requests.

Providing the get_card_last_4_digits tool replaces any step-by-step process for obtaining the last four digits. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_013]

facts_found: A 'goods_services_not_received' dispute where the purchase was made within the last 30 days is NOT eligible for provisional credit because the merchant may still be processing delivery. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

Customer guidance recommends contacting the merchant first for non-fraud issues, but says customers should contact Rho-Bank right away if they already tried the merchant without success. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]
'Goods or Services Not Received' (paid for something but never received it) is an explicitly listed valid credit card dispute reason. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]

Customers file credit card disputes by contacting customer service (1-800-RHO-BANK, mobile app chat, or rhobank.com/help); representatives gather the information and file the dispute on the customer's behalf, with account info plus purchase date, merchant name, and amount. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]

There is no customer self-service tool for credit card transaction disputes; the only customer-run dispute tool documented is submit_cash_back_dispute_0589, which applies solely to cash back discrepancies, not non-receipt of goods. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

A user's prior credit card disputes (dates, statuses, reason codes, transaction details) can be retrieved with get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id) — used to verify the 'no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months' provisional credit criterion. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

Provisional credit, when the customer is eligible, is typically applied within a few business days of filing and becomes permanent if the dispute is resolved in the customer's favor, otherwise it is reversed. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_022]
Silver Rewards Card is classified as Mid-tier (along with Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002]
Mid-tier cards allow a maximum credit limit increase of 50% of the current credit limit per request (Entry-tier 25%, Premium-tier 50%). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_006]

If a customer requests more than the tier maximum, the agent must inform them of the maximum eligible amount and ask whether they want to proceed at that amount instead. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_006]

For this customer's $15,000 current limit, the mid-tier 50% cap equals a maximum increase of $7,500, i.e. a maximum new total limit of $22,500 — the requested ~$22,500 is at (not above) the cap. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_006]

Mid-tier CLI eligibility: minimum account age 90 days, 90-day cooldown between requests, and current credit utilization below 80% at the time of submission (Entry-tier 120/120/70%, Premium-tier 60/60/90%). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_005]
The cooldown applies only if the most recent CLI request was APPROVED; denied requests do not trigger a cooldown period. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_005]
Qualification on account age occurs on or after the day the minimum is reached; utilization at or above the threshold does not qualify. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_005]
